notes.text: R10 horse: rebuild the capsule-and-sticks animal in src/horse.js as a jointed pivot hierarchy in the register of figures.js — barrel with chest/haunches, articulated neck+head, mane and tail, two-joint legs with a speed-tracking gait (walk vs gallop cadence), idle weight shifts and ear/tail flicks at rest. Keep the rider seat (RIDE_HIPS/RIDE_SEAT from player.js), collider, gait speeds and dev hooks behaviorally identical; add a __horsePose dev hook for numeric verification. Open question answered during planning: the horse head is local +X (pi/2 - yaw), which must be preserved or normalized — decide whether to keep the X-forward convention or rotate the build to +Z like the figure kit; lean to keeping horse.js internals in +X only if it avoids touching player.js, otherwise normalize to +Z for a consistent figure-kit contract.

R10 horse rebuilt in src/horse.js as a jointed pivot hierarchy: chest/barrel/haunch body with saddle+blanket at the RIDE_SEAT topline, neck+mane+head group pivoted at the withers (head carried at ~1.9 m), tail group, and four two-joint legs (hip->knee->hoof) whose gait crossfades a lateral walk (phase offsets 0/0.5/0.25/0.75) into a rotary gallop (0.05/0.15/0.55/0.65) by speed, with knee fold on the recovery stroke, suspension bob and body rock at gallop, idle weight shift/tail sway/ear flicks, and head-yaw lead into turns. Swing axis is rotation.z (the +X-forward convention); the old legs wobbled sideways because they rotated about x. Public contract (object/collider/mounted/speed/update) unchanged; window.__horsePose dev hook added in main.js for numeric verification. Choreography notes for evidence runs: mount prompt loses to NPC/examine interact targets depending on approach side (retry loop needed); dragAim turns need a closed loop against live yaw; due east from the horse hits the barn.

Evidence at job tmp r10/: before2/horse-idle-b.png shows the old capsule-and-sticks horse from the east vantage; after/ has the new rig from the same vantage (horse-idle-b), mounted side composite at rest (horse-rider-side), gallop frames (horse-gallop-chase + bracket), and the numeric probe output (walk anti-phase hips ±0.44 with knee folds, gallop 14.5 m/s with hip ±0.75/knee -1.1, suspension bobY 0.09, neck stretch -0.15->-0.48, head lead +0.013 on a measured 0.384 rad right turn, idle settle to 0). npm run check 23 PASS. Frame time on the ranch view: HEAD 37.4 ms mean / R10 32.5 ms mean - no regression. Fresh critic engaged for the perceptual verdict.

evidence.note: Fresh independent critic: matched-crop before/after at the east vantage shows capsule-and-sticks replaced by a jointed animal (carried head with muzzle/ears, mane, saddle mass, chest/haunch planes). Its own pose-probe run reproduced walk anti-phase hips +-0.46 with knee folds -0.45, gallop at 14.5 m/s with hips +-0.75, knees to -0.75, uneven phase offsets and 3x walk suspension bob, idle exactly 0 (still animal, slow tail drift). Neck tracks speed -0.15 to -0.48. Mounting/seat/collider behavior intact (probe mounts, composite shows rider seated at saddle, legs to the sides); npm run check 23 PASS; frame time HEAD 37.4 ms vs R10 32.5 ms - no regression. No new defects. Non-blocking note: head-yaw turn lead is +0.013 rad (~0.75 deg), effectively imperceptible - cosmetic.
